[1] CONFIG.md (Site configuration)
  View defaults: ```space-lua / config.set("view.defaults", { / -- The curated Navigate tree (see [[^Library/Website]]) is this site's navigation / ["docs.navigate"] = { open = true, width = 360 }, / }) / ``` / ```space-lua / -- managed-by: configuration-manager / config.set("fonts.ui", "inter") / config.set("fonts.editor", "inter") / config.set("workbench.pinnedTags", { / "page", / "task", / }) / ``` / ```space-lua / -- managed-by: workbench-schemas / -- priority: -10 / tag.define { / name = "api/lua", / schema = { / type = "object", / properties = {references = schema.array "string"}, / required = {"references"}, / }, / } / tag.define { / name = "component", / schema = { / type = "object", / properties = { / connectsTo = {anyOf = { / schema.array "string", / schema.ref(), / }}, / partOf = schema.ref(), / consumes = schema.ref(), / }, / }, / } / ```
[2] Fonts.md (Editor font size)
  SilverBullet uses three fonts, each picked separately in [[Workbench/Configuration]] under **Appearance**: / * **Interface font**: menus, panels, the page title and the [[Workbench]]. / * **Editor font**: the text of your pages. / * **Code font**: anything code-like: inline code, [[Markdown/Fenced Code Block|code blocks]], frontmatter and tables while you edit them, and `${...}` expressions while the cursor is in them. It should be a monospace font. / Instead of using the [[Workbench/Configuration]] options, you can also set them in [[CONFIG]]: / ```lua / config.set("fonts.editor", "inter") / config.set("fonts.ui", "system-sans") / config.set("fonts.code", "ia-writer-mono") / ```
  Notes for theme authors: If your [[Space Style]] sets fonts, a few things changed with this feature: / * **Code no longer follows `--editor-font`.** It uses `--editor-monospace-font`. A theme that set `--editor-font` to a monospace font, and expected code to follow, should set `--editor-monospace-font` too. / * **The editor's text size is the `--editor-font-size` variable** (18px in the theme), no longer a fixed `font-size` on `#sb-main .cm-editor`. / * **A `space-style` that sets `--editor-font`, `--ui-font`, `--editor-monospace-font` or `--editor-font-size` wins over the Configuration setting**, whether it sets them on `html` or `:root`. Remove it from your style to pick fonts in Configuration instead. / * **Numbered lists right-align their numbers** to the widest number in the list, so items `9.` and `10.` start their text in the same place.

Exact facts:
- [1] This is where you configure SilverBullet to your liking. See [[^Library/Std/Config]] for a full list of configuration options.
- [2] Editor font size**, also under **Appearance**, sets the size of page text in the editor, in pixels: 18 by default, from 10 to 48. Headings, code and list indents scale with it. A proportional font often looks smaller than a monospace one at the same size, so you may want to raise it after switching.
- [2] config.set("fonts.editorSize", 20)
